ios.desc:
The Tastermonial app simplifies nutrition labels and helps you instantly discover new foods that fit your food choices and lifestyle.

Our powerful technology goes beyond the label to offer simple, clear, and unbiased ratings of more than 400,000 foods you'll find in most grocery stores and markets. 

Complete your private, personal profile to tell us your dietary preferences, food sensitivities, and restrictions. Then simply point the Scan tool at a barcode on the back of any product and we'll instantly show you if there are any ingredients you should be concerned about like doubtful additives, hidden sugars.

Identify products that provide more of the 'good stuff' like fiber, see sugar equivalent in tsp, carb to fiber ratio to ensure you and your family feel great about what you're eating. 

If you're trying to eliminate or limit your intake of things such as carbs, trans fats, sugar, or certain ingredients due to a special eating plan, food sensitivities, or lifestyle choice, we'll help you find healthy products that meet your goals.
